profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Oscar Health
profile.summary:
I currently work for Oscar Health as a Software Engineer, working to build an affordable and accessible health insurance. I graduated from Hunter College with a bachelors degree in Computer Science.

I am passionate about creating tools and learning new technologies.

positions.title: IT Summer Intern
positions.description:
- Installed and updated cybersecurity and VPN software on Windows OS to remediate vulnerabilities.
- Provided technical assistance to office staff, providing step-by-step guides on how to troubleshoot a problem in the future.
- Set up equipment for office staff use, ensuring proper installation of cables and software.

company.name: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene

positions.title: Data Science Fellow
positions.description:
- Selected for a technical training program, as one of 183 students out of 400+ applicants.
- Learned in-demand data science/machine learning technologies as well as industry best practices for design, implementation, and deployment such as MVC, version control with Git/GitHub, Agile & Scrum with Trello and Slack, test driven development, and CI/CD.
- Enhanced soft skills by practicing behavioral interviews, pitching projects, and attending workshops.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
- Tutored middle school students in STEM subjects, primarily math and computer science
- Assisted in an after school coding program, where students learned how to use Javascript using p5.js 
- Documented records of students in order to identify a student’s needs and how to best approach them

positions.title: Teen Tutor
positions.description:
- Provided 1-to-1 tutoring in reading and writing to kindergarten, first and second grade students
- Tracked and documented student reading progress

projects.title: COVID-19 Global Vaccine Visualization
projects.description:
- In a team of two, implemented a data visualization app that visualizes vaccinations administered worldwide.
- Normalized data from Our World in Data using Pandas/Numpy and created a MySQL database on Amazon RDS to store the data.
- Used Plotly to create dynamic charts and Flask to create web application.

projects.title: SceneryLens
projects.description:
- Implemented a web app that detects scenery elements in an image, with 77% accuracy. 
- Used Tensorflow/Keras to apply transfer learning on an Xception CNN to classify 90,000 images.
- Used Flask to create a web application and deployed it on Digital Ocean.
